findings.reason: the comparison is the section's whole deliverable, and naming the reference variant (EPM, magnetics-only, monomial basis) is what makes its bands measurable rather than dependent on which of two stored equilibria the worker opened.
findings.text: §2 names "the MAST-U 45272 slice" and requires the class to fit "the same number of profile coefficients imas-efit fitted", but imas-efit's manifest carries two references at that pulse — `mastu_epm_45272` (magnetics only, monomial pp'/ff', 238 slices) and `mastu_epq_45272` (magnetics + MSE, spline pp'/ff', 183 slices) — and both entries state that "cross-comparison ... is not valid" because EPQ's spline basis and MSE constraints produce systematically different internal profiles; the monomial-basis requirement in the same paragraph is satisfiable only against EPM, so a worker choosing EPQ produces a comparison imas-efit itself declares invalid and cannot honour "the same number of profile coefficients" at all

findings.reason: a negative control that can fail to fire leaves the node's gate red on a sound fit, and the repair is one phrase in the clause rather than a re-derivation.
findings.text: §2 clause (3) constructs its control by scaling "every magnetics row and the measured plasma current" by 1.10, but under the locked `fitted-unknowns` choice the measured conductor currents are themselves fitted data weighted by their measurement uncertainty, and they are left unscaled, so the control hands the fit two mutually inconsistent data families (magnetics demanding 1.10×, coil measurements demanding 1.00×) and the fitted plasma current lands wherever the weighting arbitrates — the clause then asserts on "every case" an outcome it has not constructed; scaling the measured conductor currents and their uncertainties by the same 1.10 makes the control a physically self-consistent 1.10× state whose failure is arithmetic

response_events.note: Section 2 now names the magnetics-only MAST-U 45272 reference (imas-efit's EPM case, monomial profiles) and states that the EPQ case is not used.
